description: Norman Conquest of England.
Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland begins.
Treaty of York defines the border between England and Scotland.
William Wallace leads uprising against English rule.
Black Death arrives in Europe through Italian ports.
Black Death devastates French population.
Black Death dramatically reduces Welsh population.
Plague waves kill a third of German populations.
Dutch cities grow as major trading centers.
Henry V becomes king.
Columbus (Genoese) begins voyages leading to European colonization of the Americas.
French invasions of Italy begin the Italian Wars.
Martin Luther condemned at the Diet of Worms; Protestant Reformation gains momentum.
Act of Supremacy makes Henry VIII head of the Church of England.
Peace of Augsburg legalizes Lutheranism in the Holy Roman Empire.
English navy defeats the Spanish Armada.
First permanent English settlement at Jamestown (Virginia).
Pilgrims land at Plymouth and establish Plymouth Colony.
Roger Williams founds Rhode Island for religious freedom.
Connecticut Colony established by Puritan settlers from Massachusetts.
English seize New Amsterdam from the Dutch, rename it New York.
New Jersey established as English colony.
Growth of Danish trading empire in Northern Europe.
Kingdom of Prussia founded.
War of Spanish Succession impacts French finances and population.
Acts of Union unite England and Scotland into Great Britain.
Treaty of Utrecht ends major European conflict; Dutch influence shifts.
Piedmont-Sardinia rises as a major Italian power.
French and Indian War begins; area sees heavy colonial military activity.
Britain takes control of Canada after Treaty of Paris.
Stamp Act protests begin; rising revolutionary sentiment.
Boston Massacre heightens tensions with Britain.
Boston Tea Party protests taxation without representation.
Battles of Lexington and Concord start American Revolution.
Declaration of Independence signed in Philadelphia.
British evacuate New York City at the end of Revolutionary War.
Irish Rebellion against British rule.
Napoleonic forces reorganize Italian states.
Act of Union merges Ireland with Great Britain.
July Revolution establishes constitutional monarchy.
Reform Act expands voting rights.
Irish Potato Famine begins, causing mass emigration.
German revolutions push for democracy and unification.
Revolutions lead to early stages of Italian unification.
Mass migration to New York through Ellis Island region.
Significant immigration from Britain and Ireland to Ontario.
Italy becomes unified kingdom.
Battle of Gettysburg in U.S. Civil War.
Canadian Confederation established; Ontario becomes a province.
Franco-Prussian War; fall of Second Empire.
German Empire proclaimed in Berlin.
Mass emigration begins from southern Italy to the U.S.
Large Slovak emigration to America begins under Austro-Hungarian rule.
Coal mining industry peaks, driving migration shifts.
Rapid industrialization brings major immigrant workforce.
Ellis Island immigration station opens.
World War I begins, affecting all European migration patterns.
Spanish Flu pandemic causes global disruption.
Irish Free State established following independence struggle.
Great Depression begins, affecting migration and employment.
Nazi regime rises to power.
Germany invades France during WWII.
End of World War II; major political and migration shifts.
Post-war immigration increases, including ties to Wales and Scotland.
Treaty of Rome creates European Economic Community.
Immigration and Nationality Act alters U.S. immigration patterns.
Maastricht Treaty establishes the European Union.
Slovakia becomes an independent nation after split with Czech Republic.
